props.src: en 5.4 and zh 光华门 (no footnote): the defenders throw flaming lumber / gasoline barrels into the gap (F07, popular history, no primary source); drawn as a fire with smoke in the court at a distance, no figure in it; the lead can delete this prop without any other edit

marks.text_zh: 拂晓：第36联队在门外与教导总队一个营交火，对方损失约一半，退入城内
marks.text_en: Dawn: the 36th Regiment meets a Training Brigade battalion outside the gate; about half of it is lost and pushed inside
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F04, ja 南京戦 (the place of the clash is 推测) (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 9日起多批飞机轰炸光华门一带，守军伤亡一百多人
marks.text_en: From 9 Dec several air raids on the Guanghua area; over 100 Chinese casualties
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: T25, jp-024 (en 5.1; the hours and the aircraft are 推测) (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 两门山炮推上来，炮击城门
marks.text_en: Two mountain guns are wheeled up and shell the gate
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-024 (en 5.1; the number 2 is a single source) (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 工兵三次爆破城门，没有成功
marks.text_en: Engineers try three times to blow the gate and fail
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: raw_tactics#20 (en 5.1; hours 推测) (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 夜里守军反击大校场一带，营房起火，电灯照出攻击者
marks.text_en: At night the defenders counter-attack at the airfield side; the barracks burn; electric lights expose the attackers
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F10, raw_cn_ground#21, M21 (hour and size 推测) (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 城楼已经不在，约80米城垛被炸平
marks.text_en: The gate tower is gone and about 80 m of crenellations have been levelled
marks.label: 推测
marks.src: wall.json guanghua tower.until, crenels_gone (the hour is 推测)

marks.text_zh: 山炮直接瞄准，一轮接一轮轰击城门顶的沙袋
marks.text_en: Mountain guns fire direct, volley after volley, at the sandbags on the gate top
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F05, raw_jp_artillery#13 (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 守军的重迫击炮十几发落在日军观测所和指挥所附近
marks.text_en: More than ten heavy mortar rounds fall near the Japanese observation and command posts
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: M22 (Ncp34, single testimony) (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 工兵炸开城门东南角的残墙
marks.text_en: Engineers blow the ruined wall at the south-east corner of the gate
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F05, raw_cn_heavy#44, jp-025 (zh 17:00, Ncp34 just before 17:00, ja 17:30; en: engineers and artillery) (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 城墙东南角塌开一个缺口
marks.text_en: A breach opens in the wall at the south-east corner
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: wall.json breaches guanghua-se (at 12-10 17:00; place and size 推测); jp-025

marks.text_zh: 两个中队冲进缺口，插上了旗
marks.text_en: Two companies rush into the gap and raise a flag
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-025, F05 (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 其中一个中队88人损失80人；少佐阵亡（时间有9日、10日两说）；剩下的十几个人守住缺口里的一角
marks.text_en: One company of 88 has lost 80; the major is killed (9 or 10 Dec: disputed); more than ten men hold a corner of the gap
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: en 5.4 (Harmsen) via jp-025; Ncp34 10数名; Ito's death disputed; the hour is 推测 (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 第83军和第87师带着炮、战车和装甲车反击
marks.text_en: The 83rd Corps and the 87th Division counter-attack with artillery, tanks and armoured cars
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: T12 (en 5.4, no footnote; reliability low); the hour is 推测 (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 缺口被沙袋封上，缺口里的人被切断
marks.text_en: The opening is plugged with sandbags; the men in it are cut off
marks.label: 推测
marks.src: wall.json breaches plugged 22:00 (推测); F07 (eight hours to seal the gap, 未核实)

marks.text_zh: 11日：日军三次接近城门（唐生智的电报）
marks.text_en: 11 Dec: the Japanese approach the gate three times (Tang's wire)
marks.label: 未核实
marks.src: INV h (single source)

marks.text_zh: 12日：炮战持续一整天
marks.text_en: 12 Dec: the artillery duel lasts all day
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: en 5.x (raw_fights_south_east#46)

marks.text_zh: 14时前后：第2大队救援缺口里的人，送去弹药和食物，重炮和飞机支援
marks.text_en: About 14:00 the 2nd Battalion relieves the men in the gap with ammunition and food, supported by heavy artillery and aircraft
marks.label: 未核实
marks.src: jp-027 (Ncp34 only); wall.json: the plug of the gap ends 14:00

marks.text_zh: 第二批冲进来的日军被十余挺机枪打退，缺口再次用沙袋封死
marks.text_en: A second wave is beaten back by more than ten machine guns and the gap is sealed with sandbags again
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F08 (zh.wikipedia 光华门, no footnote visible); the hour is 推测

marks.text_zh: 17时开会决定撤退，17:30起各部开始撤；第87师仍守光华门
marks.text_en: 17:00 the meeting decides the retreat; from 17:30 units begin to leave; the 87th still holds the gate
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F28, F09 (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 凌晨2时第87师撤向下关，约400名重伤员留在门内
marks.text_en: At 02:00 the 87th Division leaves for 下關; about 400 badly wounded are left at the gate
marks.label: 未核实
marks.src: en 5.x, F09, raw_fights_north_river#36 (the 400: single source)

marks.text_zh: 约4时日军爬上几乎无人的城门
marks.text_en: About 04:00 the Japanese scale the almost deserted gate
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-026 (en: around 4 am; Japanese hours may be Tokyo time) (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)

marks.text_zh: 5时联队主力占领城门；门上万岁（朝日1938年画册里的照片）
marks.text_en: At 05:00 the regiment's main body occupies the gate; banzai on the gate top (Asahi 1938 photograph)
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-025, jp-026, Commons "Banzai on Guanghua Gate" (13 Dec, 36th Regt); the men are shown from a distance only (display; OOB.md 5, 推测)
